scope: Local-only catalogue expansion; no publication, browser bypass or PDF changes

tests.method: Node VM with minimal DOM test double plus pure logic and static checks; not browser emulation
coverage: Combined classification filters, unknown fields and distinct-title grouping
Host lookalikes, credentials, non-HTTPS URLs and nonstandard ports rejected
Provider listings external-only with no thumbnail or iframe
Explicit player creation, no autoplay, stop and selection clearing
Local-file iframe prevention, external fallback, deep links and keyboard focus
1998 Stree and 1968 Stree remain different works
Companion links resolve and scripts defer in order

implementation: Separate access, format, source, decade, sourced genre, language type and rights filters
Labelled native controls; advanced filters grouped in details/fieldset; available formats derived from data
19 official full-film uploads plus 12 conditional provider routes; existing trailers and archive song preserved
Eleven new Odia titles use explicitly labelled editorial reading forms
Provider-listed years identified as such; unknown original/dubbed status not inferred from Odia audio
Coverage ledger humanized without changing source claims; held candidates omitted
Exact provider allowlist: www.zee5.com, www.primevideo.com, www.airtelxstream.in
No raw evidence captures shipped in client data; retained research records remain canonical

quotes: use `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` to group related controls.
always associate `<label>` with its input using `for` and `id`.
ensure tap targets are at least `48px`.
guidance.application: Native labels and fieldset/legend inside expandable advanced filters; 48px controls; single-column mobile layout. Small-choice selects retained to conserve limited filter-panel space.

limitations: No exhaustive catalogue claim; source coverage remains partial
No embedded playback or browser layout test; prior local-file restriction respected, no server or alternate browser
Provider access may require payment/sign-in or vary by region
No verified public-domain films; no movies downloaded/rehosted
Original-language status, genre and dates remain unknown when evidence is insufficient
